Thanks for the confirmation and the checklist. I’ll lead the technical demo and cover the items you listed. A couple quick pre-read notes so we can keep the call tight:

- VPC options: we support VPC peering, Private Service Connect, and direct connect; will show topology diagrams and network ACLs.
- KMS/HSM: we have guides for customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS/HSM, GCP CMEK) and HSM integrations; key rotation policies supported.
- Audit logs: we stream audit logs to customer-controlled sinks (S3/GCS) and retain per policy — we’ll discuss retention/export workflows.
- On-prem: we offer an on-prem distribution for air-gapped installs; note additional lead time and license terms.

I’ve uploaded SOC 2 Type II and an encryption whitepaper to a secure share and added links to the mutual action plan. See related links in the calendar invite.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
